intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Specify whether the sleeve provides abrasion protection, bundle organisation or electrical shielding. Conductive braid requires a separate end-termination and grounding definition.
copy.zh: 明确套管用于耐磨、整理束线还是电气屏蔽；导电编织层还需单独定义端部端接和接地方式。

copy.en: Measure the largest bundle, splice and connector that the sleeve must pass over. Check expansion and recovery on a sample; nominal braid size alone does not define the installation fit.
copy.zh: 测量套管需要穿过的最大束径、接点和接口外廓，并通过样品核对扩张与回缩情况，不能只按编织套标称尺寸判断装配适配。

copy.en: Choose closed sleeving for assembly before termination or a split/reclosable sleeve for later access. Define overlap at bends and branch exits to avoid gaps after routing.
copy.zh: 端接前装配可选择闭口套管，需要后续拆装可选择开口或可重复闭合套管，并定义弯曲处与分支出口的搭接量，避免布线后露缝。

copy.en: Match cutting and edge restraint to the sleeve material. Confirm end fixation, local heat-shrink or binding and the transition at every breakout on the first article.
copy.zh: 让裁切和切口收束方式匹配套管材料，并在首件上确认端部固定、局部热缩或绑扎以及每处分支的过渡。

copy.en: Identify recurring contact with brackets, fluids, heat and moving equipment. Review sleeve material and local reinforcement at those points instead of applying one protection choice everywhere.
copy.zh: 识别与支架反复摩擦、接触液体、靠近热源或设备运动的位置，再逐处审核套管材料及局部加强方式。

copy.en: Define the exposed length, braid coverage, fastening locations and branch appearance on the sample. Use these dimensions as production inspection points rather than a general appearance request.
copy.zh: 在样品上定义裸露长度、编织覆盖、固定位置及分支外观，并把具体尺寸作为量产检验点。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
